[[Sword X Staff|About]] • [https://game.boltray.com/SwordxStaff?lang=en Official Website] • [https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61579592385490# Official Facebook]

Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.” Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all? Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different. No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?

Over [[Skill Overview|200+ skills]] are waiting for you to mix, match, and experiment, so your battles can be 100% you. And you're not alone! You'll meet [[companions]] from far and wide and take on mysterious Hieromons together!

{{Home
|header=Mix & Match! Master of Skills
|body=[[File:2 STORE PHOTO.jpg|thumb|490x490px]]
<br>Forget ordinary "lots of skills". It's about tactics, strategies, and yep, wild combos too! With in the classic dual-class system, you can mix and match however you like. Sequence techniques, switch elements, and  200+ skills try a new style every fight!

Features a classic<ref>[[Classes Overview]]</ref> Warrior–Mage foundation, expanded through multiple class branches and advanced specializations. The current version includes 6 class ranks, with a 7th rank currently in development.

Players can switch classes for free once per week<ref>[[Class Change]]</ref>, fully retaining their overall level and skill progression.

<br>The invasion is looming, protect the realm!
